name: NeuS
aliases: Learning Neural Implicit Surfaces by Volume Rendering for Multi-view Reconstruction
NeuS — Learning Neural Implicit Surfaces by Volume Rendering for Multi-view Reconstruction
definition: Designed a volume rendering technique for surface representation to improve geometric reconstruction quality.
summary: NeuS is a neural surface reconstruction method that represents geometry as an SDF zero-level set and uses an unbiased volume rendering scheme with a trainable sharpness parameter to avoid geometric bias.
